description: Start an optional Hocus Games account for a person who asked for it, with ONLY their email address and, optionally, the genres, graphics styles, themes and tones they want to hear about. We email them a confirmation link; they confirm, choose their password and accept the Terms of Service on the Hocus Games website; the account picks games for them from what they do on the site (they can turn that off on their account page) (never pass or ask for a password here). Once confirmed they get a weekly email listing newly published games with ANY of the chosen tags (only when there is at least one), and they can rate games on the website. The answer is the same whether or not the address already has an account. Playing games never needs an account. Rating games through MCP is not available (it would need MCP sign-in, OAuth, which this server does not offer yet).

email.description: The person's own email address, given by them for this purpose.

follow.description: Tags to follow for the weekly email; the same values search_games uses for these filters.
